raw.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Welcome to Motorola Solutions. By applying for this role, you will become a founding technical member of the new CC Insights team. Our hybrid team—spanning the US and South Africa—is building a unified reporting application that combines various reporting products acquired and built in-house over the past few years. We aim to deliver a seamless analytics experience featuring embedded PowerBI reports and an innovative AI-assisted workflow that empowers users to chat with their data.

This product sits on a robust data foundation powered by our internal Data Platform (BDP), leveraging Databricks and Azure Data Lake for our Bronze and Silver data layers. The new Insights team owns the Gold layer (Synapse via Databricks) and the unified web application.
You will be joining a highly collaborative group of Data and Software Engineers, while working closely with the Data Platform Engineering (DPE) team.


Job Description

We are looking for a FullStack Engineer to join our team. Your primary responsibilities will be to design and develop services and components on this stack, and to coordinate with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure.

You will drive the development of our C# backend and Angular frontend, integrate PowerBI via the Embedded SDK, and architect scalable, multi-tenant microservices. You will also play a key role in migrating functionalities from various other reporting products into our unified frontend. A commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and a thirst for elegant code is a must.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the Foundation: Develop and maintain the unified CC Insights web app, integrating embedded PowerBI reports via the Angular SDK and facilitating AI-assisted workflows.

  • Architectural Stewardship: Work within a layered architecture spanning controllers, services, repositories, and data-access components, while improving boundaries where they are weak or overly coupled.

  • Legacy Migration: Evaluate and migrate features from various reporting products into Insights, requiring code analysis of existing systems.

  • Data & Multi-Tenancy: Develop and optimize multi-tenant data access patterns using EF Core, SQL Server, and tenant-aware access controls.

  • Platform Capabilities: Build and maintain cross-cutting platform capabilities including authentication, authorization, feature flags, observability, metrics, logging, exception handling, and resiliency policies.

  • Frontend Engineering: Contribute to frontend state management patterns using Angular and centralized state tools such as NgRx.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead technical design and code reviews, identify architectural risks early, and drive pragmatic improvements rather than cosmetic rewrites.

  • Operational Excellence: Debug production issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers using logs, traces, and metrics. Partner with product, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to deliver features with clear operational ownership.

  • DevOps & Pipeline Automation: Design, build, and manage robust CI/CD pipelines utilizing GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps (ADO) to ensure seamless continuous integration, automated testing, and reliable deployment of our C# backend and Angular frontend services.

  • Mentorship: Mentor other engineers through design guidance, code review, and engineering standards.


Basic Requirements

  • Core Backend Skills: Proficient in C#, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems. Familiarity with the .NET framework as well as .Net Core, alongside a strong understanding of object-oriented programming.

  • Frontend Expertise: Experience with Angular or a comparable modern frontend framework, plus familiarity with frontend state management patterns.

  • AI Coding Proficiency: Highly proficient in utilizing modern AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate development, aid in code comprehension, and improve overall code quality.

  • System Architecture: Experience working in layered or modular monolith architectures with dependency injection and interface-driven design. Ability to make sound architectural decisions in an existing codebase without defaulting to unnecessary rewrites.

  • Multi-Tenant Systems: Experience building or maintaining multi-tenant systems, including data isolation and tenant-aware authorization patterns.

  • Reliability & Observability: Experience with distributed-system reliability practices (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts, defensive error handling) and observability tooling (structured logging, metrics, tracing, production diagnostics).

  • CI/CD Pipeline Development: Hands-on experience building, configuring, and managing CI/CD pipelines from scratch. Strong proficiency with GitHub Actions, GitHub Repositories, and Azure DevOps (ADO) for automated builds, testing, and release management.

  • Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

  • Design Patterns: Familiarity with various design and architectural patterns. Familiarity with Domain Driven Design and Event Sourcing would be advantageous

  • Unit Testing: Experience in writing unit tests to ensure code quality.

Beneficial Skills

  • Knowledge of PySpark and SQL to better collaborate on the Databricks/Synapse data pipelines.

  • Prior experience with LLM integrations (e.g., OpenAI, LangChain, Azure AI) to support chat-assisted workflows.

  • Complete understanding of React and its main fundamentals.

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work, you’ll get:

  • PTO 20 Days

  • Life Cover - Life, dread disease, salary protection - this is covered in full by RD and not out of CTC.

  • Fully Remote (within South Africa) - we will set you up to work from home with a laptop and necessary accessories.

D-Wave (NYSE: QBTS), D-Wave is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. We are the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the only company building both annealing and gate-model quantum computers. Our mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum, today. Our quantum computers — the world’s largest — feature QPUs with sub-second response times and can be deployed on-premises or accessed through our quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations trust D-Wave with their toughest computational challenges. With over 200 million problems submitted to our quantum systems to date, our customers apply our technology to address use cases spanning optimization, artificial intelligence, research and more. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how we’re shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

You can read more about our company and our innovations in the pages of The Wall Street Journal, Time Magazine, Fast Company, MIT Technology Review, Forbes, Inc. Magazine, Wired and across many whitepapers.

At D-Wave, we’re helping customers realize the value of quantum computing today and are shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow.

About the role

Are you passionate about working with cutting-edge technology, collaborating with world-class minds, and guiding intellectual property through evolving product lifecycles? Do you enjoy intellectually challenging patent drafting and prosecution in a collaborative, supportive environment?

Join our Intellectual Property (IP) team as an In-house Patent Agent / Lead Patent Specialist and contribute your expertise to our growing patent portfolio. This role is suited for a strong independent contributor with clear communication skills, capable of managing complex work and collaborating across teams.

You will work closely with external counsel and internal technical experts, operating with a high degree of independence to proactively identify roadblocks, manage priorities, and exercise sound judgment on when to escalate. You will have the opportunity to contribute to an expanding global patent strategy and other diverse IP initiatives.

What you'll do

  • Draft and prosecute patents across a range of technical areas
  • Build strong working relationships across IP, legal, and technical teams
  • Develop a solid understanding of company technology and collaborate with inventors to identify and assess valuable innovations
  • Clearly communicate IP education and guidance to internal stakeholders; coordinate effectively with external counsel
  • Contribute to the management and continuous improvement of the IP portfolio
  • Proactively identify and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and quality
  • Independently manage a varied workload, balancing priorities and timelines
  • Anticipate challenges, propose solutions, and escalate when appropriate
  • Continuously build expertise in the quantum technology landscape and stay current in IP best practices

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in physics, math, computing science, electrical engineering, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in patent drafting and prosecution before the Patent Office
  • Registration as a Canadian Patent Agent (or equivalent) is an asset
  • Strong analytical thinking and sound judgment in solving complex problems
  • Clear and effective communication skills adaptive to a variety of audiences
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and a solutions-oriented mindset

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

General Function:

The Lead Innovation Software Engineer partners across Technology, Product, Strategy, and line-of-business teams to help define and demonstrate the future of Fifth Third Bank’s products, services, and enterprise architecture. This is a hands-on innovation role for a builder, strategist, and collaborator who can connect human-centered design with strong technical depth. The person in this role helps teams evaluate and apply emerging technologies, modern engineering practices, and new ways of working to accelerate product innovation and improve delivery. They may lead a major initiative or several smaller efforts while influencing stakeholders and development teams toward modern, practical solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with production squads on meaningful, high-priority initiatives while gaining a deep understanding of the bank’s technology stack, products, and delivery environment. By pairing strategic thinking with real-world execution, the Lead Innovation Software Engineer helps turn ideas into practical demonstrations, prototypes, and capability visions that can influence enterprise direction.

We are looking for someone with strong curiosity, a forward-looking mindset, and a passion for staying current on emerging technology and fintech trends. The Lead Innovation Software Engineer should be an active user of artificial intelligence and a thoughtful advocate for responsible adoption. This person brings creativity, analytical thinking, and strong communication to the role, using data, prototypes, and other tangible artifacts to explore ideas, improve processes, and help others understand what is possible and how we might achieve it.

The Lead Innovation Software Engineer will be responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. This position acts as the liaison between the Risk, Audit and Analytic teams. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Fifth Third Bank’s current and future-state technology and product architecture
  • Help shape the bank’s evolution as a product-led enterprise built on a modern technology foundation
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to expand enterprise technology capabilities in support of customer and product innovation
  • Partner with engineers, architects, and line-of-business leaders to envision, demonstrate, and develop new or improved financial products, business processes, and technology-enabled capabilities
  • Lead end-to-end data workflows including extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) from structured and unstructured sources; perform quantitative and qualitative analysis; and develop interactive dashboards and visualizations (e.g., Power BI) to support decision-making, stakeholder reporting, and product insights.
  • Identify, evaluate, and benchmark fintechs and emerging startups by analyzing their technology architecture, product capabilities, business models, and financial viability; synthesize findings into comparative assessments and strategic recommendations aligned to enterprise priorities and market relevance.
  • Influence enterprise thinking on the future of technology across innovation, software development, fintech, artificial intelligence, and digital assets
  • Lead or contribute to research and evaluation of emerging design, technology, industry, and market trends
  • Translate customer needs, competitor activity, industry shifts, and technology developments into actionable insights
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to team members and partners
  • Recognize meaningful patterns across industry, technology, and cultural change and explain their business impact
  • Use systems thinking to connect ideas across products, platforms, teams, and enterprise capabilities
  • Design solutions with the broader business and technology ecosystem in mind
  • Apply structured problem solving and root cause analysis to address challenges and uncover new opportunities
  • Recommend technology options and design approaches to senior leaders and key stakeholders
  • Create compelling narratives, demonstrations, prototypes, and communications that bring concepts to life
  • Share lessons learned, best practices, and new ideas across the team and broader organization

Supervisory Responsibilities: None.

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • 5+ years of experience in roles closely aligned to the responsibilities of this position
  • Strong front-end development experience delivering commercial solutions using modern web standards and frameworks such as HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, React, Vue, or similar tools
  • Strong back-end development experience working with APIs, services, event-driven architectures using Kafka, databases, SQL, and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, with a clear understanding of how front-end frameworks integrate with back-end systems
  • Deep experience with at least one server-side language such as Python, Java, Node.js, or PHP
  • Infrastructure experience building, configuring, and supporting scalable web applications in cloud or hosted environments such as AWS or Azure
  • Experience with modern server-side tooling, deployment practices, and hosting models
  • Experience working in a mature DevOps environment using version control, CI/CD, and automated testing practices
  • Proficiency with generative AI for productivity and full-lifecycle software development
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL and modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), along with experience building and consuming data pipelines across both real-time/event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, APIs) and batch/integration patterns for one-off or analytical use cases
  • Familiarity with end-to-end data lifecycle—from ingestion through transformation to visualization—including use of analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) and/or integrated data platforms (e.g., Dataiku) to support business insights and decision-making
  • Strong understanding of agile product development and iterative delivery
  • Working knowledge of blockchain, digital assets, smart contracts, and web3 technologies
  • Ability to make sound design decisions and clearly explain the rationale behind them
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to build trust with team members, business partners, and customers and use those relationships to identify new opportunities
  • Commitment to mentoring others and sharing knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned
  • Ability to identify meaningful opportunities for change and translate them into effective design or technology responses
  • Comfort working iteratively, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and adapting based on feedback
  • Strong attention to detail

Job Summary:

Why Geisinger:

Geisinger is operationalizing AI at scale across one of the nation's most integrated health systems, moving beyond pilots and proof of concepts to build capabilities that change how care is delivered and how operations run. This role works across clinical, operational, health plan, and pharmacy functions alongside AI product development and organizational leadership to identify and advance the AI opportunities that matter most.

This role keeps Geisinger AI product squads moving with clarity and discipline, creating the conditions where strong ideas actually ship.

Position Summary:

This is a role for someone who gets energy from making teams work better. You will be embedded across Geisinger AI product squads, helping cross functional groups that span product, data science, engineering, and clinical operations move faster, communicate better, and deliver with consistency. You will adapt your approach to fit how each team actually works rather than enforcing a rigid framework, and you will be the person who sees problems coming before they become blockers.

Job Duties:

Key Responsibilities

  • Make cross functional AI product squads more effective by facilitating planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily coordination in whatever form fits each team best

  • Coach product managers, data scientists, engineers, and clinical partners on agile principles and how they apply in a complex healthcare environment

  • Identify and resolve blockers before they stall delivery, managing dependencies across product, platform, governance, and clinical teams and escalating when needed

  • Maintain clear visibility into tasks, issues, risks, and action items across squads, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks as work moves through the delivery cycle

  • Plan and organize sprint demos and product testing events, ensuring the right stakeholders are involved and that feedback loops are tight and productive

  • Collaborate across IT, clinical, and operational teams to ensure the right people are engaged at the right time and that resource gaps do not quietly become delivery problems

  • Track and improve the health of delivery across the portfolio, using flow metrics and team feedback to identify where things are slowing down and why

  • Keep portfolio leadership informed on delivery progress with timely, accurate, and actionable status communication

  • Support onboarding of new team members and champion a culture of continuous improvement across the AI product function

Work is typically performed in an office or remote environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.

*Relevant experience may be a combination of related work experience and degree obtained (Associate’s Degree = 2 years; Bachelor’s Degree = 4 years; Master’s Degree = 6 years).

Position Details:

Required Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of experience in an agile delivery, facilitation, or team lead role in a complex enterprise environment

  • Demonstrated ability to flex across delivery frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid approaches

  • Agile certification such as CSM, PSM, or equivalent; SAFe or advanced certifications a plus

  • Strong facilitation and conflict resolution skills with the ability to create psychological safety on teams

  • Familiarity with backlog and delivery management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and organizational complexity in large health systems or similarly regulated industries

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting AI, data science, or machine learning product teams

  • Exposure to Epic implementation or healthcare IT delivery environments

  • Experience supporting multiple product teams simultaneously within a larger delivery program

  • Understanding of healthcare operations, clinical informatics, or revenue cycle workflows

Minimum of 5 years-Relevant experience* (Required), Minimum of 3 years-Managing people, processes, or projects (Required)

Communication, Critical Thinking, Interpersonal Communication, IT Environment, Leadership, Multitasking, Teamwork, Working Independently

OUR PURPOSE & VALUES: Everything we do is about caring for our patients, our members, our students, our Geisinger family and our communities.

  • EXCELLENCE: We treasure colleagues who humbly strive for excellence.
  • LEARNING: We share our knowledge with the best and brightest to better prepare the caregivers for tomorrow.
  • INNOVATION: We constantly seek new and better ways to care for our patients, our members, our community, and the nation.

We offer healthcare benefits for full time and part time positions from day one, including vision, dental and domestic partners. Perhaps just as important, we encourage an atmosphere of collaboration, cooperation and collegiality.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Full-Stack Web App Developers (JavaScript/TypeScript + Python or Node) to join the Tendem project () and build interactive browser-based applications for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your full-stack engineering expertise to design, build, and maintain functional, robust, and user-friendly web applications. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end-to-end.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores.
  • Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role-based access where needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features.
  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

Staritas is seeking a Senior Manager, Data Engineering to lead its enterprise data engineering function, including data platform strategy, roadmap execution, modernization, production operations, data quality, governance, and team development.

raw.title: Senior Customer Support Representative
raw.excerpt: ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents.
raw.description:
ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities around the world. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products.

Role Overview

As a Customer Support Specialist III (Level 3 Triage) at ECP, you serve as the final Support escalation point and primary technical triage resource before issues are escalated to Dev, Pharmacy, Billing, Compliance, or Product. You are responsible for reproducing complex customer issues, validating bugs, and ensuring that only well-documented, actionable cases reach downstream teams.

This role focuses on deep technical investigation, quality control, and proactive product support. You act as the bridge between Support & other teams—reducing noise, improving issue quality, and helping ensure smoother releases through active participation in testing prior to product launches.

In addition to triage responsibilities, this role supports continuous improvement by identifying systemic issues, strengthening documentation, and enabling Levels 1 and 2 through knowledge sharing.

Core Responsibilities

Technical Triage & Issue Replication

  • Serve as the final Support escalation point for complex or ambiguous issues prior to Engineering or Product involvement
  • Reproduce reported issues in staging or test environments to confirm behavior and isolate root causes
  • Perform detailed technical investigation across product workflows, integrations, and configurations
  • Determine whether issues represent product defects, configuration problems, or expected behavior
  • Gather logs, screenshots, steps to reproduce, and environmental context to create complete, actionable tickets
  • Act as a gatekeeper for escalations, ensuring only validated (to the best of ability) and properly documented issues are passed to Engineering
  • Assisting with categorization of severity and prioritization of tickets and issues
  • Monitor ticket data for trends and work proactively with leadership to address
  • Act as a triage between support & Dev, “translating” ticket information to be digestible in both directions
  • Act as backup for management needs when manager out of office or requires assistance

Bug Validation & Release Support

  • Validate suspected bugs by confirming reproducibility and impact
  • Assist Engineering by providing clear reproduction steps, test scenarios, and customer context
  • Participate in regression testing and validation of fixes prior to deployment
  • Support Product and Engineering during release cycles by assisting with QA and pre-launch testing
  • Help identify potential customer-impacting issues before product launches

Documentation & Systems Management

  • Maintain highly detailed ticket documentation following ECP best practices
  • Ensure accurate categorization and tracking of bugs and escalations in HubSpot and ECP’s ticketing system
  • Contribute to internal technical documentation, troubleshooting workflows, and release notes

Knowledge Sharing & Team Enablement

  • Provide feedback loops Support regarding root causes and resolutions
  • Deliver teach-backs after triaged issues to improve frontline troubleshooting and reduce escalation volume
  • Serve as a technical product expert and trusted resource across Support
  • Identify recurring patterns and recommend training, documentation, or product improvements

Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain ownership of triaged issues through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up and cross-team communication
  • Consistently meet or exceed established KPIs, SLAs, and quality standards
  • Balance triage workload with testing, documentation, and team enablement responsibilities

Expectations for Success in This Role

  • Demonstrate strong ownership of technical investigations and escalation quality
  • Exhibit advanced analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Deep understanding of all of our product offerings
  • Ensure Engineering receives complete, reproducible, and well-scoped tickets
  • Proactively improve Support effectiveness through documentation and coaching
  • Maintain a customer-first mindset while operating in a highly technical capacity
  • Uphold ECP values and represent Support professionally across all teams

Requirements

Requirements

    • 3+ years Customer Service Experience
    • 1+ years escalated Technical Support Experience
    • Strong understanding of Billing/Financial terminology & process is preferred
    • Software experience, experience with JIRA, ServiceDesk, & UAT is preferred
    • Strong problem-solving capabilities, ability to replicate and test suspected bugs
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills & ability to clearly communicate steps taken for replication, and suspected issues.
    • Comfort learning new systems and technologies quickly
    • Bachelor or Associate's degree preferred
    • A remote work environment that is compliant with cybersecurity and other company workplace policies
    • Work Hours / Schedule:
      • The regular work hours will be 8:00 am CT ( 6:00 am PT, 7:00 am MT, 9:00 am ET) to 5:30 pm CT (3:30 pm PT, 4:30 pm MT, 6:30 pm ET), Monday through Friday.
      • Support team members are required to participate in the on-call/after-hours rotational schedule

A posição de Analista de CRM - Adobe Journey Optimizer fará parte da área de Martech da AI/R Webjump, representará e auxiliará a companhia em seus objetivos de negócios atendendo clientes enterprise.

A Webjump é a única Adobe Platinum Partner da América Latina especialista em Commerce, Target e AEM, com sede em San Francisco (USA) e escritório em São Paulo (BR) e parte do AIR Group. Oferecemos todas as soluções da Adobe Experience Cloud para nossos clientes e valorizamos a inovação, excelência e o comprometimento, com uma equipe de profissionais talentosos e cultura colaborativa, buscamos melhoria contínua em um ambiente humanizado.

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de CRM com vivencia solida em Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — tanto em implementacao quanto em operacao continuada de projetos. Esta posicao surge para suprir uma lacuna tecnica no time e exige alguem que ja tenha operado o AJO em ambiente produtivo, com familiaridade com a arquitetura da Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) e os canais digitais suportados pela ferramenta. Voce sera responsavel por configurar, operar e evoluir jornadas de comunicacao multicanal (E-mail, Push, Web Push, WhatsApp, SMS), trabalhar em projetos de migracao de plataformas legadas para o AJO, e garantir a continuidade operacional das campanhas dos nossos clientes enterprise. O perfil ideal une capacidade tecnica de implementacao com visao estrategica de CRM e ciclo de vida do cliente.

• Configurar, operar e evoluir jornadas omnichannel no Adobe Journey Optimizer — campanhas transacionais, promocionais e informacionais — nos canais de E-mail, Push, Web Push, WhatsApp e SMS

• Participar ativamente de projetos de migracao de plataformas legadas de automacao de marketing (ex.: Oracle Responsys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para o AJO, incluindo levantamento de inventario, priorizacao de fluxos criticos e traducao da logica de negocio para a arquitetura do Journey Optimizer

• Realizar provisionamento e habilitacao de canais no AJO: configuracao de IPs dedicados, dominios de envio, plano de IP Warming, integracao com provedores de SMS (ex.: Infobip) e Mobile SDK para Push

• Criar e gerenciar segmentos e audiencias com base em perfis unificados da Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) — incluindo datasets de perfil, evento e lookup com esquemas XDM

• Monitorar e garantir a entregabilidade (deliverability) das comunicacoes: reputacao de IP/dominio, taxas de abertura, bounce, spam complaints e ajustes de warmup

• Apoiar a integracao do AJO com fontes de dados externas via API e conectores nativos (ex.: CRMs, plataformas de streaming, SDKs web e mobile)

• Acompanhar a qualidade e consistencia dos dados carregados no AEP: pipelines de ingestao batch e streaming, resolvendo inconsistencias que impactam a orquestracao das jornadas

• Criar e manter documentacao tecnica das configuracoes, jornadas e integrações — garantindo rastreabilidade e governanca das operacoes

• Reportar KPIs de performance das campanhas: open rate, CTR, conversao por canal, saturacao de comunicacao e engagement — propondo otimizacoes com base em dados

• Colaborar com times de Martech, Dados e negocio do cliente para garantir que as jornadas reflitam a estrategia de CRM e os objetivos de ativacao financeira ou comercial

Requisitos e Qualificacoes

• Formacao em Marketing, Publicidade, Administracao, Sistemas de Informacao, Engenharia ou areas correlatas

• Experiencia comprovada com Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — tanto em implementacao (provisionamento, configuracao de canais, integracao) quanto em operacao de campanhas em producao

• Conhecimento da arquitetura da Adobe Experience Platform (AEP): datasets, schemas XDM, pipelines de ingestao, perfis unificados e identity resolution

• Vivencia com gestao e execucao de campanhas de CRM multicanal em ambientes de alta escala (bases de milhoes de contatos)

• Capacidade de interpretar logica de negocio e traduzi-la em configuracoes tecnicas de jornada no AJO (regras de entrada, divisoes de decisao, conteudo personalizado em tempo real)

• Perfil autonomo, atento a detalhes, com boa capacidade de comunicacao com stakeholders tecnicos e de negocio

Conhecimento de Ferramentas

• Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — configuracao de jornadas, campanhas, canais e motor de decisao em tempo real

• Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) — ingestao de dados, schemas XDM, perfis unificados, segmentacao e governanca

• Adobe Real-Time CDP — criacao e ativacao de audiencias, identity resolution e integracao com destinos

• Mobile SDK (iOS e Android) — configuracao para Push Notifications e coleta de eventos de comportamento em app

• Web SDK / Adobe Launch (Tags) — tagueamento de propriedades digitais para coleta de dados comportamentais

• Ferramentas de monitoramento de deliverability (ex.: painel de reputacao de IP/dominio, logs de bounce)

• Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — acompanhamento de comportamento digital e metricas de canal

• Power BI ou Looker Studio — construcao de dashboards de performance de campanhas

• Jira / Confluence — gestao de tarefas e documentacao tecnica em ambientes ageis

Hard Skills

• Configuracao e operacao de jornadas no AJO: canais Email, Push, Web Push, WhatsApp e SMS

• Modelagem de schemas XDM e datasets de perfil, evento e lookup no AEP

• Gestao de deliverability: IP Warming, configuracao de dominios, SPF/DKIM/DMARC e monitoramento de reputacao

• Criacao e ativacao de segmentos e audiencias dinamicas com base em comportamento e propensao

• Integracao de sistemas via API REST e conectores nativos Adobe (batch e streaming)

• Conhecimento de processos de migracao de plataformas de automacao de marketing — mapeamento de campanhas, validacao de dados e cut-over com zero downtime

• Logica de personalizacao em tempo real: motor de decisao, regras condicionais e conteudo dinamico no AJO

• Configuracao de politicas de consentimento (opt-in / opt-out) e controle de privacidade e saturacao de comunicacao — conformidade LGPD

• HTML / CSS para edicao e ajuste de templates de e-mail transacional e promocional

• Analise de metricas de CRM: open rate, CTR, conversao, churn e LTV — com capacidade de propor otimizacoes baseadas em dados

Idiomas

• Portugues: fluente (obrigatorio)

• Ingles: avancado — leitura de documentacao tecnica Adobe Experience League e comunicacao com parceiros internacionais

Diferenciais (Desejaveis)

• Certificacao Adobe Journey Optimizer ou Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)

• Experiencia em projetos de migracao do Oracle Responsys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ferramenta equivalente para o AJO

• Vivencia com programas de fidelidade (loyalty), aviacao, servicos financeiros ou varejo de alta escala

• Conhecimento em Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) para analise de jornadas e comportamento omnichannel

• Familiaridade com arquitetura de dados em nuvem: pipelines Lambda/Streaming, Databricks ou BigQuery como fontes de ingestao para o AEP

• Experiencia com configuracao de Mobile SDK para ingestao de eventos de comportamento em app (tagging de atributos e eventos de usuario para unificacao de perfis no RT-CDP)

• Conhecimento em Adobe Sensei / IA generativa aplicada a personalizacao e decisao no AJO

• Vivencia em metodologias ageis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestao como Jira

• Pos-graduacao, MBA ou especializacao em Marketing Digital, Martech, CRM ou Gestao de Dados

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

Candidato, toda nossa comunicação com você é via e-mail ou por telefone. Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam.

E fique atento nas ligações pois nossos telefones corporativos tem variação de DDD.

Boa seleção!

  • Gestão e Suporte à Carteira: Gerenciar uma carteira de franqueados, sendo o ponto focal para suporte, dúvidas e orientações sobre os produtos da FVC.
  • Relacionamento com o Franqueado: Construir e manter um relacionamento próximo com os franqueados da sua carteira, compreendendo suas necessidades diárias e garantindo sua satisfação.
  • Análise de Desempenho: Acompanhar os dados de desempenho e uso dos produtos FVC na sua carteira, identificando pontos de atenção e oportunidades de melhoria para reportar ao seu gestor.
  • Execução de Estratégias: Apoiar na implementação das estratégias definidas pela liderança para maximizar os resultados dos franqueados, garantindo que eles entendam e apliquem as melhores práticas.
  • Monitoramento e Reporte: Monitorar de perto os indicadores (KPIs) de progresso da sua carteira em relação às metas e preparar relatórios claros para acompanhamento.
  • Apoio à Expansão: Auxiliar no plano de adoção e expansão dos produtos FVC dentro da sua carteira, apresentando os benefícios e ajudando no processo.
  • Seguir Processos com Qualidade: Aplicar os processos padronizados de atendimento e gestão, garantindo um serviço eficiente e de qualidade para a rede.
  • Canal de Feedback: Ser o primeiro ouvinte do franqueado, coletando feedbacks, dúvidas e sugestões, e direcionando corretamente para as áreas responsáveis dentro da empresa.
  • Colaboração Interna: Interagir com áreas de suporte e outras equipes internas para garantir a resolução ágil das demandas dos franqueados.
  • Graduação completa em Administração, Marketing, Gestão de Negócios e afins;
  • Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de dados utilizando o SQL, Looker e Tableau.
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas do google sheets (planilha, apresentação).
  • Experiência na construção e apresentação de materiais executivos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial (NotebookLM, Gemini, etc.)
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas, priorizar tarefas e ter iniciativa para resolver problemas do dia a dia.
  • Habilidade de se comunicar de forma objetiva, didática e empática, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito.
  • Habilidade para analisar dados de desempenho, identificar padrões básicos e ajudar na solução de problemas.
  • Orientação clara para ajudar o cliente a ter sucesso e para o atingimento das metas e KPIs definidos.
  • Facilidade para construir e manter relacionamentos de confiança com franqueados e colegas de equipe.
  • Interesse em aprender continuamente sobre nossos produtos, processos e sobre o negócio do franqueado.
  • Flexibilidade para se adaptar a mudanças em processos e demandas diárias, mantendo o foco e a qualidade do atendimento.
  • Flexibilidade para viagens pontuais, visita aos franqueados, encontros de time e reuniões de planejamento.

Informações adicionais

raw.title: Group Product Manager, Finance Technology
raw.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Role

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.

You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.

You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
  • As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
  • Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
  • Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
  • Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
  • Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
  • Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
  • Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
  • Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
  • Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
  • Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
  • Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.

Strategic Orchestration & Influence

  • Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
  • Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.

Team Leadership

  • Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
  • Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
  • Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
  • Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
  • Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Hands-On Product Ownership:

  • Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
  • This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
  • Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.

Vendor and Demand Management

  • Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
  • Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
  • Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
  • Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
  • Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
  • Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
  • Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
  • Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
  • Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
  • Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
  • Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
  • Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
  • Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
  • Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a high-growth public technology company
  • Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
  • Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
  • Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)
  • Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems
  • Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models

Why This Role, Why Reddit

Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.

You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:
$210,800—$295,200 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
Titre : Stagiaire en architecture technologique — Socle IA corporatif (Ouvert)

Lieu : Télétravail, mode hybride ou en présentiel au bureau de Rimouski

Période : 8 septembre au 18 décembre 2026

PG Solutions est en train de poser les bases de son futur corporatif en intelligence artificielle, et nous souhaitons que tu en fasses partie. Sous la supervision d’un expert en développement logiciel et en IA, tu auras l’opportunité rare de participer à un chantier stratégique qui façonnera la façon dont notre organisation exploitera l’intelligence artificielle dans ses produits et ses services. Ce stage n’est pas un stage d’observation — tu y contribueras concrètement, tu laisseras une trace durable et tu repartiras avec une expérience réelle en architecture IA.

Tes responsabilités :

  • Contribuer à définir l’architecture de référence du socle IA corporatif de PG Solutions ;

  • Évaluer et comparer les technologies clés (LLM, orchestration, stockage vectoriel, API, etc.) en lien avec notre vision IA-first ;

  • Concevoir et réaliser un prototype fonctionnel permettant de valider les concepts architecturaux retenus ;

  • Produire des livrables documentés, clairs et réutilisables par l’équipe interne ;

  • Proposer une feuille de route technique pour accélérer le déploiement de futures solutions et assistants IA ;

  • Collaborer activement avec l’équipe dans un esprit d’ouverture et de partage.

Profil recherché :

Compétences techniques :

  • Connaissance des fondements de l’intelligence artificielle et du machine learning (LLM, RAG, agents IA, etc.) ;

  • Aptitude à concevoir ou à analyser des architectures logicielles (microservices, API REST, cloud) ;

  • Familiarité avec des environnements Python et les écosystèmes IA courants (LangChain, OpenAI, HuggingFace ou équivalents) ;

  • À l’aise avec les outils de versionnement (Git) et la documentation technique.

Compétences analytiques :

  • Capacité à analyser des options technologiques, à formuler des recommandations claires et à documenter tes conclusions de façon structurée.

Travail d’équipe :

  • Aisance à communiquer tes idées et à recevoir de la rétroaction ;

  • Capacité à avancer de façon autonome tout en restant aligné avec l’équipe ;

  • Ouverture d’esprit et volonté de partager tes apprentissages.

Curiosité et proactivité :

  • Intérêt marqué pour l’intelligence artificielle et les architectures modernes ;

  • Motivation à contribuer à quelque chose de concret et de structurant ;

  • Débrouillardise, initiative et envie d’apprendre en faisant.

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Impact réel : Tu contribueras directement à un projet stratégique — ton travail sera utilisé, pas archivé ;

  • Encadrement expert : Un expert t’accompagnera au quotidien, avec son expérience en développement logiciel et en IA ;

  • Apprentissage accéléré : Tu seras au cœur des technologies IA les plus actuelles, appliquées à un contexte d’entreprise réel ;

  • Flexibilité : Horaires flexibles et possibilité de télétravail ;

  • Ambiance collaborative : Une équipe accessible, transparente et engagée qui valorise tes idées.

Si tu as envie de mettre tes connaissances en IA et en architecture au service d’un projet qui compte vraiment, et que tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement stimulant où ton apport sera reconnu et valorisé, nous serions ravis de t’accueillir dans l’équipe pour un stage qui marquera ton parcours.

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi.

Les candidatures des femmes, des personnes handicapées, des personnes autochtones et des minorités visibles sont encouragées. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L’équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris ne communique jamais par message texte pour solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler uniquement aux postes publiés. Les personnes retenues seront contactées par un gestionnaire de Harris ou un membre de l’équipe de recrutement pour une entrevue.

raw.description:
The Senior Director of Brand & Communications is a strategic and creative leader responsible for shaping and stewarding the voice, brand, and narrative of the organization across all internal and external channels, ensuring that every communication advances the organization’s mission, reflects its values, and tells the story of its impact and commitment to justice-centered philanthropy around the globe. This role leads the development and execution of a comprehensive communications strategy that advances the organization’s mission and business development, strengthens its visibility and credibility, and fosters alignment and engagement among staff, partners, and the broader philanthropic and social impact ecosystem.

Reporting to the Co-Chief Executive Officer, the Director oversees all aspects of brand management, digital and media strategy, Office of the CEO and executive leadership communications, storytelling, and internal communications. This role ensures the organization’s communications reflect its values, highlight its work and impact, elevate its voice and visibility, and connect authentically with diverse philanthropy audiences—including grantees, funders, staff, global collaborators, and the public. The Senior Director understands the power of narrative to; drive systems change, promote RPA’s mission, commitment to equity, community-centered messaging. the proven ability to translate complex work into compelling, accessible content.

Accountabilities

Strategic Communications Strategy and Execution

  • Develop a communications and branding strategy aligned with the organization’s mission and strategic plan.

  • Partner with leadership as relevant to ensure clear, cohesive messaging in RPA’s voice across all internal and external platforms including newsletters, website, social media, and publications.

  • Refine the organization’s voice, brand, and narrative in a way that centers justice and equity and is grounded in cultural competence.

  • Determine approaches and messages that align with mission and brand that support RPA’s continued viability and sustainability, including key audience channels and aligned messages that support donor development and partnerships.

  • Elevate the visibility of RPA’s thought leadership in partnership with Inquiry and Insights.

  • Serve as strategic advisor to the Co-CEOs on messaging and public speaking.

External Communications and Public Engagement

  • Lead media relations, including proactive press outreach, rapid response, and relationship management with journalists and sector influencers.

  • Oversee the digital strategy and content, including website, social media, newsletters, and multimedia storytelling and provide direction to the team on implementation.

  • Partner with executive leadership and teams across the organization, including core teams, Advisory, and Sponsored Project leadership to support communication efforts around key initiatives, events, and campaigns and amplify programmatic, core operations, and thought leadership work.

  • Maintains enterprise-wide awareness, including major sponsored project communications and provides executive counsel and risk-based communications guidance for complex, high-visibility, or sensitive matters that may impact the organization's reputation, stakeholders, or strategic objectives.

  • Develop and oversee processes for tracking initiatives, campaigns, and outreach.

Internal Communications

  • Design and implement internal communications systems that strengthen employee connection, clarity, and alignment.

  • Collaborate with core teams to ensure transparent and timely communication during change, growth, or strategic planning efforts.

  • Build resources to support staff in communications opportunities and engagements (e.g., media training, message alignment, sharing on social media, etc.).

Media, Brand Stewardship, & Visibility

  • Refine and protect the organization’s brand identity and voice across all touchpoints, ensuring alignment with values of justice, equity, trust, and community.

  • Oversee brand assets and ensure consistency across visual design, tone, and messaging.

  • Manage organizational media presence, including pitching, placements, and media relationships.

  • Partner with functional leaders to develop, manage, and curate strategic visibility opportunities for Co-CEOs, executive leadership, and colleagues, thoughtfully positioning them to represent RPA externally.

  • Maintain and strengthen a coherent, values-aligned brand identity and experience.

Complexity and Problem-solving

  • Uses expertise to act as an organizational authority on planning, organizing, prioritizing, and overseeing communications activities to efficiently meet RPA’s objectives.

  • Exercises independent judgment in developing solutions to apply a comprehensive understanding of the sector environment and the organization’s objectives, developing solutions while providing guidance to others.

  • Applies expertise to act as the organizational authority on maximizing RPA’s brand impact and market value by managing and developing all aspects of the brand.

  • Works at an advanced level and exercises broad decision-making authority in developing communications and brand strategies, navigating ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and aligning leaders to achieve organizational objectives.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Direct supervision of communications staff

  • Management of external vendors, agencies, and consultants

  • Collaboration with cross-functional leaders on integrated campaigns and messaging.

Travel Requirements

Some travel may be required.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, public relations, or related field or equivalent experience required (12+ years).

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and verbal communications skills

  • Proven senior level experience developing and executing communications strategies, including digital strategy, in a nonprofit, philanthropic, or mission-driven organization.

  • Strong understanding of social justice, equity-focused language, and narrative change principles.

  • Track record of managing media relationships, digital platforms, and brand identity systems.

  • Familiarity with philanthropy sector audiences and the communications nuances of donor/grantee/stakeholder engagement.

At Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors, our mission is to accelerate philanthropy in pursuit of a just world, by providing deep global expertise to make philanthropy more thoughtful, equitable and effective.

  • We believe that philanthropy can help create a better world

  • We make decisions that center people and communities.

  • We believe philanthropy has a responsibility to pursue equity.

  • We uphold the highest standards of integrity and trust.

  • We are committed to learning and sharing knowledge.

If our mission resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. You may bring valuable perspectives and experiences that aren’t captured here but could contribute meaningfully to our work. We’re excited to learn what you can offer.

Compensation & Benefits

Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including health coverage, retirement benefits, paid sick leave, vacationand holidays, tuitionreimbursement and access to professional development resources.

The salary range is one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Pay Range: $195,000 - $205,000 salary per year

Application Process

Applications will be reviewed as received. In order to be considered, all applications must include a cover letter describing your interest and qualifications and your resume. The position will remain open until filled.

Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors celebrates the uniqueness of our staff, our partners, and the communities we serve. We are committed to inclusion with the goal of cultivating a culture of belonging and acceptance. We strive to embed this value in our philanthropic work to advance a more just, equitable and sustainable world.

RPA is an equal opportunity employer.
