Job Title: Product Certification Auditor (Client Manager)
Reports to: Operations Manager in UK

Location: Home based

Purpose of the position:
As the face of BSI, the role of the Auditor (Client Manager) is to work closely with BSI clients to help them improve their performance by assessing their systems and processes against BSI standards. At the end of each assessment the Client Manager compiles a business report and presents this to the client.
Context / Dimensions:
The scope of the position will typically cover clients within the region of the role holder however some wider UK delivery may be required. The role is home-based.

Are you ready to be part of a world-renowned organization with nearly 120 years of innovation, growth, and industry leadership? Do you have a passion enabling organisations to continue maintaining high standards of compliance?

At BSI, we are looking for a Built Environment Auditor to play a key role in maintaining product excellence. In this role, you’ll conduct product certification assessments across varied environments, ensuring compliance with BSI’s rigorous certification schemes and Kitemark standards.

We are seeking professionals to deliver Building Information Modelling (BIM) related product assessment in accordance with ISO 19650 framework. Previous auditing experience is a plus, as well as expertise in quality management systems (ISO 9001). Experience with PAS 2080 (Carbon Management in Infrastructure) would also be a distinct benefit.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Prepare assessment reports and deliver findings to clients to ensure client understanding of the assessment decision and clear direction to particular items of corrective action where appropriate
  • Recommend the issue, re-issue or withdrawal of certificates, and report recommendations in accordance with BSI policy, procedures and prescribed time frame.
  • Maintain overall account responsibility and accountability for nominated accounts to ensure an effective partnership, whilst ensuring excellent service delivery and account growth.
  • Lead assessment teams as required ensuring that team members are adequately briefed so that quality of service is maintained and that effective working relationships are sustained both with Clients and within the team.
  • Provide accurate and prompt information to support services, working closely with them to ensure that client records are up to date and complete and that all other internal information requirements are met.
  • Coach colleagues as appropriate especially where those members are inexperienced assessors or unfamiliar with clients' business/technology and assist in the induction and coaching of new colleagues as requested
  • Plan/schedule workloads to make best use of own time and maximise revenue-earning activity.
  • Responsible for attending any required training and following all procedures/processes/policies within BSI for management of clients, management of a home based office, use of BSI equipment and communication both internal and external to the organization
  • Must be willing to go through extensive onboarding plan in order to reach Lead Assessor status through the prescribed program (based on the knowledge, skills and experience they have as well as the requirements of the appropriate schemes)
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge and skills, to include preparation for and taking standardized assessments related to knowledge and application of audit practices
  • Responsible for managing a portfolio of assigned clients based on location and a match of qualifications and client contract requirements
  • Responsible for contacting clients and scheduling the visits, planning the assessments, making travel plans, conducting the assessments and reporting and managing the results in an efficient manner.
  • Responsible for monitoring the client accounts to ensure that records, visit cycle, invoicing and other related matters are properly dealt with to assure client satisfaction is maintained
  • Responsible for leading teams, when necessary, and mentoring and coaching new or inexperienced colleagues as needed to meet the business needs
  • Any other assignments as needed to meet assessment delivery business objectives.

Education/Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 4 years’ industry experience gained within BIM, Built Environment, Construction or similar industry sector
  • Expertise across ISO 19650, Building Information Modelling (BIM) Framework
  • Experience with PAS 2080 Carbon Management in Infrastructure would be desirable
  • Previous experience in 3rd party external auditing, against standards
  • Can travel frequently
  • Knowledge of quality management system (ISO 9001) auditing practices.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

raw.title: Mentor, Claude Corps
raw.excerpt: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country.
raw.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States

Role-Type: Full-Time, W2 Employee

Reports To: Senior Manager of AI Practice, Claude Corps

Compensation: $110,000 to $124,500 per year

Start Date: September 21st, ahead of the October 19th cohort launch

Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. A fellowship is only as good as the engineer riding alongside the fellow when something breaks at midnight. As a CodePath Mentor, that engineer is you.

You are the full-time technical coach for a portfolio of roughly ten pods: about 20 fellows across 8-12 host organizations, from pre-Basecamp through the final day of the program. You are the coach that develops the fellow: you have first eyes on every pull request, you catch the patterns when something is off, and you proactively resolve any roadblocks that come up. The host org directs the fellow's day-to-day work, the curriculum team owns what they learn, and your Sr. Manager of AI Practice is the manager of record who holds the performance bar. Your job is to make each fellow better at the work.

The work is mostly written and asynchronous: code review on pull requests, feedback on roadmap drafts and quarterly business reviews, weekly office hours, and a few synchronous deep dives when something needs more than text. You will not be the deepest expert in the room for every fellow, and we are honest about that. You carry the throughline: you know your pods end to end, see patterns nobody else sees, and pull in deeper expertise the moment a single fellow needs it.

This role is built for engineers who would rather coach 20 engineers through real production work than ship one feature themselves. You are a few years further down the road than the fellows: enough professional reps to read code with judgment, a real coaching instinct, and the AI-native practice fellows are being trained to build.

Key Responsibilities

Coach your pods

  • Carry roughly 10 pods (about 20 fellows across 8 to 12 host organizations) full-time from pre-Basecamp through final day, calibrating your time across the portfolio rather than sinking into one pod

  • Have first eyes on every fellow's pull request, and give structured written feedback on their real work (PRs, roadmap drafts, architecture proposals, QBR deliverables) at the cohort's pace, not your inbox's

  • Facilitate weekly 1:1s with all of the Fellows that report to you and document their progress, challenges, and successes using the tooling that Claude Corps operates on

  • Lead each fellow's Day 30/90/180/270 milestone review; you own the fellow-level synthesis and hand it up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the roll-up and the performance call

Deliver the curriculum in your pods

  • Deliver the just-in-time modules the curriculum team designs; author lane- or pod-specific content when they commission it, because you have seen the gap from closer in

  • Frame and debrief the cohort-wide all-hands your Sr. Manager of AI Practice runs, and the sessions where the curriculum team or a guest teaches your fellows directly

  • Co-lead the Basecamp practical assessment alongside Anthropic's instructors; it is your first calibration on each cohort

Keep the program honest

  • When the same problem shows up across three fellows, raise it to the right owner: the Claude Corps leadership team for program efficacy, the curriculum team for curriculum, partner experts for technical depth, host-org managers for a host issue, or your Sr. Manager of AI Practice for a delivery or performance issue

  • Be the first stop when a fellow's technical work is at risk; surface it to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the escalation

  • Work AI-natively: Claude is core to your coaching loop for code review, pattern-spotting, and feedback at scale, and fellows should see you working the way they are being asked to work

Key Success Metrics

  • You have surfaced the top three cohort-wide technical patterns to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice and the curriculum team

  • 100% of host-org managers you've worked with in the last 30 days can produce one concrete example of your impact

  • Every Day 30 review is done and documented, handed up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, with a plan for any fellow whose work is at risk or ready for the next challenge

Qualifications

Required

  • 2 to 4 years of professional software engineering on a real team: long enough to have opinions about code, short enough to remember being the most junior engineer in the room

  • Real coaching or mentorship reps, formal or not: an intern you saw through a summer, a teammate you onboarded, a bootcamp you TA'd. We are hiring the instinct, not a management title

  • You can read a pull request you didn't write, in a stack you don't use every day, and give feedback that is specific and useful

  • You have shipped production work with AI-assisted development tools and can describe specifically how your workflow changed; you have to be ahead of the fellows on this curve

  • You are comfortable as a generalist coach: you find the answer or the right person quickly, and you trust partner experts to carry the depth you don't

  • Strong written communication; most of your feedback is asynchronous, read by people who don't speak your stack

  • Comfortable with remote, synchronous obligations across US time zones and about two evenings a month for cohort sessions and milestone reviews

Preferred

  • TA, bootcamp coach, fellowship mentor, or instructor experience in a cohort program, even informally

  • Experience at a small or scrappy organization where engineering meant translating business context into technical decisions

  • Comfort across at least two of: web full-stack, data/AI engineering, ML, infra/devops

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for an Individual Contributor level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $124,500. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Senior Contract Associate is responsible for drafting, negotiating, and finalizing complex Clinical Site Contracts related to clinical trials throughout the lifecycle of the study, and performs timely and accurate data entry into all Clinical Business Operations operating systems, including but not limited to the company Contract Management System (CMS). The Contract Associate is also responsible for meeting deliverables with high quality and within the project timelines. The contracting activity supported by the CBO team is fast-paced, with short deadlines and quick turnaround times therefore Contract Associate must be capable of managing priorities effectively, proactively communicating issues and working in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Functions of the job:

  • Prepare, negotiate, and finalize clinical trial agreements, ancillary agreements and amendments of company sponsored studies through direct communication with sites.
  • Responsible for execution of contracts against planned timelines and targets.
  • Manage budget grid in the contract. Ensure the cost calculation are consistent with protocol and agreed with site.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of records management requirements for contract documents
  • Complete quality check (QC) of final approved contract and budget documents, and initiates signature process of assigned contracts to the responsible signing parties.
  • Ensure final contracts are delivered to agreed timelines, within Fair Market Value & in compliance with relevant legal and regulatory requirements
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between CBO and Global Clinical Operations (GCO), Legal, Investigator Sites and external service providers in accordance with the study related activities to meet business needs;
  • Collect and maintain country and site intelligence information for each country and/or site, and prepares country/site specific contract process flows as needed;
  • Forecast, set, track and communicate fully executed contract planned dates, and make all efforts to achieve the set planned date, ensuring the CM and study teams are proactively informed of changes and/or risks to the projected dates;
  • Liaise with CM and BeiGene legal to review and update contract template(s) as needed, including Master Clinical Trial Agreements/Clinical Trial Agreements/Project Agreements or any other Site agreement template(s);
  • Liaise with CM and BeiGene legal to contribute updates to the BeiGene Legal Playbook guidance document as needed;
  • Liaise with Investigator Payment Management (IPM) team to ensure site contracts, including investigator site budgets, are approved and executed in accordance with CBO guidelines and BeiGene policies;
  • Ensure all investigator contracts are reviewed and approved by legal and/or delegate prior to execution, and in accordance with CBO and BeiGene legal guidelines;
  • Communicate legal and budgetary issues to internal and external parties per department guidelines, as needed;
  • Perform legal translation of contract language for Sites, as needed;
  • Maintain active and regular communication with site personnel and internal BeiGene partners, with regular progress tracking and updates provided throughout the contract lifecycle;
  • Prepare subsequent contract amendments, note to files and other related contract documents, as needed;
  • Escalates contracting issues and/or potential delays to internal and external stakeholders, as necessary;
  • Attend and actively participate in Investigator Site, project related, CBO, and other meetings, as necessary;
  • Update and maintain CBO trackers with real-time updates on a regular basis, complete CBO related filing and distribution of contract documents, and maintain Contract Management System (CMS) records, in accordance with CBO and BeiGene policies;
  • Provides a handoff to the project/payment team upon execution of a site’s final contractual documents

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree with 3 or more years clinical research site contracting and budgeting with evidence of increasing responsibility within a pharmaceutical company, CRO or relevant industry vendor or
  • up to four (4) years in clinical operations, preferably within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry.

Computer Skills:

  • Microsoft Office apps, CTMS, Contract Lifecycle Management System, Veeva, Jira, Beep/Sharepoint

Other Qualifications:

  • Experience with Clinical Trial Agreements, budgeting and fair market value principles
  • Explain data, facilitate decision-making processes to be data-driven
  • Good knowledge of ICH-GCP, pharmaceutical related regulations and laws;
  • Good understanding of clinical trial contracting process, and relevant clinical operation practices;
  • Awareness and understanding of compliance and regulatory matters in clinical research.
  • Proven negotiation, interpersonal and business skills.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills and the ability to work independently and effectively in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.
  • Sense of urgency and strong goal orientation; track-record of meeting deadlines and goals.
  • Strong written and verbal communication including written and verbal fluency in English and local language (if not English) and interpersonal skills, including conflict resolution and problem solving.
  • Proactive and positive team player. Able to maintain high performance during times of ambiguity and change in the work environment.
  • Experience in financial, budget, cost management/analysis, accounting, and/or financial planning skills are desirable
  • Has knowledge of Intellectual Property issues, Publication issues, Indemnification issues and other standard issues of site contracts within the clinical research area.
  • Must be willing to work in a fast-paced environment with time-sensitive material.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively at all levels of an organization.

Travel: Yes, 10%

Salary Range Germany: 69,800.00 EUR - 87,200.00 EUR

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

Role: Amazon Account Executive (Wholesale)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time (Permanent)

Who We Are?

Leverify LLC is an e-commerce company and a power seller on Amazon. We are a leading electronics wholesale distributor providing exceptional partnership experiences to resellers and businesses in North America. At the same time, the company aims to contribute to Pakistan’s economy by empowering youth and businesses.

What We Value?

Leverify is an employee-centric organization focused on growth, ownership, and continuous development. We encourage employees to take responsibility, solve problems, and collaborate in a friendly yet challenging environment. Our flat organizational structure promotes open communication between team leads, directors, and employees across departments.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute pricing strategies to maximize Buy Box ownership while maintaining target profit margins.
  • Monitor and optimize Amazon FBA listing prices based on market trends, competition, and inventory levels.
  • Analyze competitor pricing trends and recommend strategic pricing adjustments.
  • Track product pricing performance using Keepa and other pricing intelligence tools.
  • Configure and manage repricing rules, pricing parameters, and price limits (Min/Max/MAP).
  • Monitor Buy Box performance, including competition from FBA and FBM sellers.
  • Perform daily margin analysis to ensure pricing decisions meet profitability targets.
  • Review promotions, discounts, and pricing opportunities to improve sales performance.
  • Identify slow-moving and aged inventory and recommend pricing strategies for better sell-through.
  • Maintain pricing logs, decision records, and performance reports.
  • Collaborate with sourcing and inventory teams to support profitable pricing decisions.
  • Ensure compliance with Amazon pricing policies and manufacturer MAP requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or above in Business, Management Sciences, Finance, or any relevant field.
  • 1–3 years of experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (Wholesale/FBA preferred).
  • Strong understanding of Amazon Buy Box dynamics and pricing strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Keepa and Amazon market analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret pricing and sales data.
  • Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple ASINs and priorities.
  • Experience with repricing tools and automation is preferred.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Market competitive salary
  • Internet and Gym allowance
  • Home-office setup
  • Annual performance appraisal
  • Leaves (Medical, Casual, Maternity, and Paternity)
  • Employee development and engagement activities

Note: Leverify is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, irrespective of race, color, religion, gender, or disability. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and consider all qualified applicants for employment without discrimination.

raw.description:
The Role, Director of Marketing Operations

GoCanvas and SiteDocs work together as part of the Nemetschek Group to streamline construction and field operations. GoCanvas specializes in digital fieldworker collaboration and compliance, while SiteDocs, a GoCanvas solution, focuses on workplace safety management through mobile and web apps. Together, these platforms create a unified ecosystem that improves efficiency, safety, and collaboration across construction projects.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Director of Marketing Operations to lead and scale the marketing operations function across GoCanvas and SiteDocs. This role will be responsible for the systems, processes, data infrastructure, and operational frameworks that power our global marketing organization.

Reporting to the VP of Global Marketing, this leader will oversee the full marketing operations ecosystem — including marketing technology, lead management, automation, reporting, and cross-functional operational execution.

The Director of Marketing Operations will ensure our marketing programs run efficiently, that leads flow seamlessly through our systems, and that leadership has clear visibility into marketing performance and pipeline impact. A core focus of the role is driving operational excellence and speed of execution by establishing scalable processes, systems, and governance that enable fast, reliable marketing execution; driving project prioritization and cross-team alignment to ensure initiatives move forward quickly and efficiently; and leading continuous operational improvements that increase speed, efficiency, and marketing impact.

This role requires a strategic operator who can build scalable infrastructure while also driving complex cross-system projects across multiple platforms and teams.


Your Most Important Initiatives:

Marketing Technology & Systems

  • Own and optimize the marketing technology stack across both brands

  • Ensure systems are integrated, scalable, and aligned with marketing, sales, and partner workflows

  • Oversee platform administration, integrations, and ongoing system improvements

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve marketing efficiency, accelerate execution, and scale operations

Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Lead Generation / Business Development Specialist to help identify new business opportunities, engage potential clients, and build a consistent sales pipeline.

The ideal candidate has proven experience in outbound prospecting, cold calling, and cold email outreach. This role requires someone who communicates confidently, works independently, and can consistently generate qualified meetings. Experience using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to improve research, messaging, and productivity is also essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and identify potential clients that match the target customer profile.

  • Generate and qualify leads through outbound prospecting.

  • Conduct cold calls and personalized cold email campaigns.

  • Deliver brief and engaging introductory presentations to prospective clients.

  • Build rapport, identify business needs, and communicate the company’s value proposition.

  • Handle initial questions and objections professionally.

  • Follow up consistently with prospects and schedule qualified meetings for the sales team.

  • Build, organize, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Keep lead information, outreach activities, and follow-up notes accurate and updated.

  • Use AI tools, including Claude and ChatGPT, to support prospect research, outreach personalization, and productivity.

  • Track performance and consistently meet agreed activity and appointment-setting KPIs.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Proven experience in lead generation, business development, appointment setting, or a similar outbound sales role.

  • Strong cold-calling and cold-email outreach experience.

  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

  • Confidence in delivering short presentations and speaking with decision-makers.

  • Strong prospecting, lead qualification, follow-up, and objection-handling skills.

  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.

  • Experience using CRM systems, email outreach platforms, and lead-generation tools is an advantage.

  • Organized, resourceful, self-motivated, and results-oriented.

  • Ability to generate opportunities and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.

  • Reliable internet connection and a professional remote-work setup.

  • Available to work full-time during US Eastern Time hours.

  • Must not have any secondary employment or other professional commitments that may interfere with the role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently generating qualified leads and meetings.

  • Maintaining regular and professional follow-ups with prospects.

  • Keeping the sales pipeline organized and up to date.

  • Meeting agreed outreach, lead-generation, and appointment-setting KPIs.

  • Using AI tools effectively while keeping outreach personalized and authentic.

About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors—industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a Solutions Engineer to join our Sales team. You'll partner closely with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle, acting as the bridge between how homebuilders work today and what becomes possible with Higharc, translating real-world workflows into a compelling, data-driven vision for each prospect.

What You'll Do

You’ll act as the liaison between typical Homebuilder workflows and practices and the vision of a more data driven and tech forward approach using the Higharc platform. Expect to:

  • Lead discovery sessions with homebuilders to uncover current-state workflows, pain points, and priorities across Design, Sales, Purchasing, and Estimating

  • Shape solution strategy in partnership with AEs, guiding prospects toward a future-state vision powered by Higharc

  • Lead platform demonstrations that help buyers envision their business running on Higharc

  • Build ROI narratives, business cases, and playbacks that quantify impact and align internal stakeholders

  • Champion the Challenger sales approach — teaching new perspectives, tailoring for relevance, and taking control of the sales process

  • Inform messaging, objection handling, and competitive positioning through field feedback

  • Support post-sale discovery, onboarding, or training for strategic accounts as needed to maintain continuity and sharpen pre-sales narratives

About You

You’re a sharp communicator, workflow translator, and platform evangelist. You love diving into customer operations, identifying opportunity gaps, and crafting persuasive, insight-led solutions that move deals forward.

You have:

  • Industry experience in homebuilding, construction tech, or proptech

  • Deep understanding of one or more homebuilding functional areas: Estimating, Design, Sales, Finance, Land, or Purchasing

  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to tailor messaging for executives and day-to-day users alike

A plus if you also bring:

  • Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM tools

Working at Higharc

Higharc has been remote first since our founding in 2018. We offer flexible hours so you can do your best work without missing out on life. Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company.

Personal healthiness is an important value for us- we provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. Haven't worked remotely before? We provide a stipend to create the ideal home office.

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

We're looking for someone to own our entire performance creative system - from research and messaging to creative production, testing, and scaling winners across Meta, Google, TikTok, and advertorial funnels.

You'll have significant ownership over our creative strategy and will work directly with the founders to shape the direction of our customer acquisition efforts.

This is not a branding, social media, or content marketing role. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled direct-response paid acquisition creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands and is obsessed with performance.

What you'll own

  • Creative strategy across all platforms: Meta, Google, advertorials, TikTok paid (Spark Ads + whitelisted creator content)
  • Full funnels: landing pages, advertorials, VSLs, email sequences
  • Research angles hooks: customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, competitor ad libraries
  • Creative briefs for editors, UGC creators, and designers
  • Scripting + copy oversight: you write or heavily edit scripts, headlines, and page copy
  • Daily performance reads on hook rate, ROAS, thumbstop rate, CTR, creative fatigue, and other key metrics - you decide what to kill, scale, and iterate
  • Production pipeline: sourcing UGC creators, managing editors, and ensuring a consistent pipeline of fresh creative assets ready for testing
  • Structured testing frameworks - one variable at a time

Success in this role is measured by improvements in ROAS, CPA, hook rate, CTR, creative win rate, and the speed and quality of creative testing and iteration.

You are

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
  • Deep direct-response background - you understand customer psychology, hooks, messaging frameworks, and how to turn insights into high-converting creatives
  • Fluent in Meta and at least one of the following: Google, TikTok Paid, or advertorial syndication (Outbrain/Taboola)
  • You've owned a creative pipeline end-to-end - from research and strategy through production, launch, and performance analysis
  • Strong written English - you write or heavily edit creative briefs, scripts, headlines, and landing page copy
  • A hands-on operator. Not a deck-maker. Not a strategist who hands ideas off to someone else to execute.
  • You use AI daily to accelerate research, messaging, scripting, creative ideation, and operational workflows. AI fluency is non-negotiable.
  • Comfortable working closely with founders in a fast-paced environment and incorporating feedback quickly
  • Experience collaborating with video editors, designers, and UGC creators to bring winning concepts to life
  • Bonus: Experience with creative analytics and research tools such as Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ads Library, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar platforms
  • Bonus: Understanding of FTC compliance

Schedule

  • Fully remote
  • Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)

raw.description:
Job Description:

The Accounting Manager, is responsible for the complete and accurate reporting of financials, ensuring strong financial controls, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to support business objectives while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability. A Manager follows the direction of senior management and ensures that the team or department is properly staffed, employees have the training and tools needed, OKRs are achieved, and the department operates within approved budgets. This role serves as a tactical leader responsible for day-to-day operations, decision-making, and team performance.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of accounting professionals

  • Hire, train, evaluate performance, and provide ongoing feedback to team members

  • Assign and prioritize work to meet service targets and deadlines

  • Communicate departmental policies, procedures, and strategy

Financial Reporting & Controls

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, including review of both internal and external reporting

  • Oversee billing processes to confirm accuracy and completeness of revenue

  • Ensure liabilities are properly recorded, including accruals for unapproved invoices

  • Maintain strong controls, documentation, and segregation of duties across the function

  • Partner with internal and external audit teams as needed

Accounting Operations

  • Oversee and manage cash reconciliation processes, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies

  • Review and approve balance sheet account reconciliations, ensuring proper documentation and support for all account balances

  • Support and oversee revenue recognition processes, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards (ASC 606)

  • Manage accounting activities related to capitalized software (internal-use software), including tracking and proper capitalization practices

  • Oversee lease accounting activities, ensuring proper application of ASC 842

  • Manage prepaid expenses and related amortization schedules, ensuring accuracy and appropriate expense recognition

  • Support preparation of financial statements and management reporting

Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across accounting processes

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support organizational goals

  • Provide consultative support to stakeholders across the business

  • Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, and values

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 6–8+ years of relevant accounting experience

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting

  • Experience managing or leading teams

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

While not required, a strong combination of the following experience is highly desirable:

  • Experience with Workday Financials

  • Knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606)

  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business model

  • Background in banking, fintech, or financial services

  • Experience managing offshore or global resources

  • Familiarity with IDSW capitalization (internal-use software accounting)

  • Knowledge of lease accounting (ASC 842)

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and timely financial reporting with strong internal controls

  • Well-managed accounting processes with minimal errors or delays

  • High-performing team that meets service and reporting objectives

  • Strong collaboration across departments and stakeholders

  • Continuous improvement in efficiency, scalability, and compliance

Work Environment

  • Collaborative, fast-paced environment working with cross-functional teams

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously

  • Interaction with internal leadership, external auditors, and key stakeholders

As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit

CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits Summary

CSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email us at and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue stream. The Renewal Account Executive position will focus on the achievement of renewal targets for Samsara’s Commercial accounts. This role is responsible for ensuring his/her customers are set up for success while maximizing the financial results for Samsara. For each deal, this means minimizing financial attrition, locking in the most favorable terms, identifying growth opportunities, passing findings and insights back to the business, and closing 36-month renewal deals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers' value earned the trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 100+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end
  • Exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage proactively with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to strategically solve problems, upsell, and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Proactively identify and contribute to material improvements in how the team functions
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years of full cycle closing sales experience, ideally working with mid-sized businesses in a high transaction environment
  • A track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Comfort with a rapidly changing, high-growth environment
  • Empathy for customers and team members
  • Highly organized
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Familiarity with Salesforce

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$66,640—$88,200 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

raw.description:
Job Description

The Head of Technology leads Tallo’s engineering and technology organization, developing and supporting the existing team and growing the structures and systems that power a career platform serving early talent. This leader manages engineering managers (currently 2 roles) who lead software engineering and QA teams, sets the technical direction for the platform, and partners closely with Product, Data, Marketing, and company leadership to translate strategy into execution. This is one of the most important roles in the organization.

The Head of Technology is accountable for the structure and health of the engineering organization, the soundness of Tallo’s technical architecture, delivery against the product roadmap, and the long-term evolution of the platform, including where and how AI and machine learning create real product value. This is a working leadership role. The person in this seat earns trust through direct engagement with the team, not from the sidelines. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

HOW WE WORK:

This leader builds an engineering organization that lives Tallo’s core values: we craft systems over individual heroics, we choose outcomes for users over internal comfort, we prioritize ruthlessly over pleasing everyone, and we offer effective help over artificial harmony. These values work together as one operating system, and we count on them most when decisions are hard. Everything this role builds, from team structure to architecture to where we invest in AI, ties back to our three company goals: Engagement, Outcomes, and Growth.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Organization & People Leadership

  • Take over an existing engineering team and develop and support it, building a culture that crafts durable systems over individual heroics and holds itself accountable to user outcomes.
  • Own the structure of the engineering organization, evolving it from where it is today and growing it as the product and roadmap require.
  • Set clear expectations for the engineering manager role, including how EMs partner with product managers and the staff engineer.
  • Hire exceptionally well across the engineering organization, and onboard and coach engineering managers with the context and support they need to lead well.
  • Identify the strongest technical leaders on the team, including the lead architect, staff engineer, and senior developers, and empower them with the trust and scope to increase their impact.
  • Establish engineer leveling and development paths so engineers at Tallo have a clear picture of growth and how to get there.
  • Make it clear to every member of the engineering team how they’re doing and how they can increase their impact.
  • Set clear standards for engineering quality, ownership, and accountability at each level.

Systems, Process & Engineering Culture

  • Own and continuously improve core engineering practices: sprint cadence, code review standards, and release process.
  • Own quality assurance, setting the standards and practices that make sure what Tallo ships works and holds up.
  • Define how technical authority and people and delivery authority work together across the staff engineer and engineering managers.
  • Champion agile, iterative ways of working grounded in a shared understanding of user goals.
  • Keep engineering work connected to user outcomes and product goals, not just feature delivery, so teams understand why they’re building what they build.
  • Guide the platform and enablement team on balancing cross-cutting feature work (auth, notifications, shared components) with maintenance and infrastructure work (tech debt, CI/CD, environment improvements), keeping platform priorities aligned to what feature squads need.
  • Set the model for mobile native engineering that best serves the product and team.

Architecture & Technical Direction

  • Set and evolve technical architecture and standards across the platform, ensuring solutions are secure, performant, scalable, and sound.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly across short-term feature delivery and long-term technical investment, including identifying and addressing technical debt to reduce risk.
  • Influence build versus buy decisions, vendor partnerships, and long-term platform investments.

Safety, Security & Compliance

  • Own safety and security for technology, making sure the platform protects its users and their data by design.
  • Work with Operations and other teams on compliance, given Tallo’s young user base and the regulatory expectations that come with it.
  • Own the technology relationship with the parent company (Stride), meeting its security, compliance, and reporting requirements while keeping Tallo moving.

Data Partnership

  • Partner with the data and data science team on the direction of the function and the technical decisions that shape it.
  • Collaborate on data architecture that powers Tallo’s metrics framework, product analytics, and reporting, making sure it’s sound and scalable.
  • Work with data science on methodology and prioritization, connecting the work to product and business questions.
  • Partner on data quality standards and monitoring, and help shape and hire for the data engineering roles the team needs.

Marketing & Operations Partnership

  • Partner with Marketing on ongoing SEO, organic search, and platform performance work that drives growth.
  • Work with Operations and cross-functional teams to make sure engineering supports the systems and workflows the business runs on.
  • Bring engineering into business conversations early so technology decisions support how the company operates and grows.

Product Partnership & Roadmap Delivery

  • Partner with the principal PM, head of insights lab, and product managers on roadmap priorities, sequencing, and capacity planning.
  • Ensure engineering teams have the context to make good tradeoff decisions, including not just what to build, but why it matters and what success looks like.
  • Connect every engineering effort to Tallo’s company goals of Engagement, Outcomes, and Growth, and to the metrics that track progress against them.
  • Identify and clear blockers to delivery across teams, including dependencies, requirements, resourcing, and cross-team coordination.

AI / ML Strategy

  • Evaluate realistic AI and ML use cases given Tallo’s data, user base, and product goals, including matching, recommendations, career path prediction, skills inference, and content personalization.
  • Recommend where Tallo should and should not focus on AI and ML, framed around Engagement, Outcomes, and Growth, and distinguish what can be done in the near term from what requires more mature data infrastructure.
  • Advise on tooling and infrastructure decisions for ML work, including model hosting, experimentation, and evaluation, building a foundation that scales as the landscape changes.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Report to the CEO with close day-to-day partnership with the Principal PM on priorities, roadmap alignment, and strategic context, and regular collaboration with Marketing and Data.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and represent technology in executive forums, giving visibility into progress, risks, capacity, and investment tradeoffs.
  • Communicate regularly with leadership on progress, priorities, and emerging opportunities, and raise issues early. Choose effective help over artificial harmony when hard things need saying.
  • Build a strong working partnership across Tallo and its parent company (Stride).
  • Establish and track engineering metrics such as delivery throughput, quality, reliability, and team health, and use the data to improve outcomes.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Directly supervises engineering managers, who in turn lead software engineering and QA teams, along with senior individual contributors as assigned. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Deep experience in software engineering and senior leadership of multi-team organizations.
  • An exceptional hirer who consistently identifies, attracts, and lands strong engineers and engineering leaders, and builds teams that raise the bar.
  • Proven experience leading engineering managers and building team structures, leveling frameworks, and operating models.
  • A track record of identifying and empowering strong technical leaders, giving them the scope to grow their impact.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling engineering organizations in high-growth environments.
  • Strong background in modern cloud-based architectures, DevOps practices, and distributed systems.
  • Track record of shipping customer-facing product capabilities, including data-driven or AI-enabled features, into production.
  • Experience owning quality assurance and the standards and practices that keep what a team ships reliable.
  • Ownership mindset for technology safety and security, with experience building secure systems and meeting compliance requirements, ideally for sensitive or young user populations.
  • Experience partnering with data and data science functions, including data architecture and analytics.
  • Excellent people leadership skills, including coaching managers, building performance cultures, and developing technical leaders.
  • Strong strategic thinking paired with a hands-on execution orientation. Comfortable working directly with the team rather than leading from a distance.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
  • Ability to clear required background checks.

CERTIFICATES AND LICENSES:

None required.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: Stride, Inc. considers a person’s education, experience, and qualifications, as well as the position’s work location, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value when determining a new employee’s salary level. Salaries will differ based on these factors, the position’s level and expected contribution, and the employee’s benefits elections. Offers will typically be in the bottom half of the range.

We anticipate the salary range to be $132,365-$195,000. Eligible employees may receive a bonus. This salary is not guaranteed, as an individual’s compensation can vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to, geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions. Stride offers a robust benefits package for eligible employees that can include health benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • This position is virtual and open to residents of the 50 states and D.C.

Job Title: Performance Video Editor (Meta Ads & Ecommerce)
﻿Location: Remote
﻿Reports To: Marketing Team
﻿Work Shift: Flexible with overlap during Australian business hours as needed
﻿Working Hours: Full-Time Preferred

Job Description

We are seeking a highly creative Performance Video Editor to help us produce high-converting video advertisements that drive customer acquisition across Meta and other paid social channels.

As we continue to grow our ecommerce brand globally, we're looking for someone who can become our primary video editing resource, transforming raw footage, UGC, creator content, and existing brand assets into compelling direct-response advertisements. You'll work closely with our marketing team to bring campaign ideas to life while continuously producing creative assets that improve advertising performance.

This role is responsible for editing paid social advertisements, developing multiple creative variations for testing, repurposing existing content into fresh marketing assets, and applying performance marketing principles to every piece of creative produced. While creative direction will initially come from our team, we're looking for someone who understands what makes advertising creative successful and can contribute ideas that improve execution over time.

This is not a traditional video editing role focused solely on creating visually appealing content. Success requires someone who understands direct-response marketing, consumer attention, retention, and performance creative. We're looking for someone who enjoys creating ads that generate measurable business results, not just beautiful edits.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Video Editing

  • Edit high-performing video advertisements for Meta and other paid social platforms

  • Transform raw footage, UGC, creator content, and existing brand assets into compelling advertisements

  • Create multiple creative variations to test different hooks, messaging, pacing, and calls-to-action

  • Optimize videos for mobile-first viewing and platform-specific best practices

  • Repurpose existing content into fresh advertising creatives

Creative Production

  • Collaborate with our marketing team to execute creative briefs

  • Apply strong storytelling, pacing, and editing techniques that maximize viewer retention

  • Organize and manage creative assets across multiple campaigns

  • Maintain consistent brand quality while producing performance-driven advertising creatives

  • Deliver creative assets accurately and on schedule

Performance Optimization

  • Incorporate campaign feedback into future creative iterations

  • Continuously improve editing quality based on advertising performance

  • Stay current with ecommerce advertising trends and platform best practices

  • Identify opportunities to improve editing workflows and production efficiency

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience for ecommerce or direct-response marketing

  • Experience creating performance-driven video advertisements for Meta or other paid social platforms

  • Strong understanding of direct-response marketing, customer attention, retention, and creative performance

  • Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar editing software

  • Experience editing short-form advertising creatives

  • Experience editing fashion, apparel, lifestyle, or DTC ecommerce brands

  • Experience editing UGC and creator-style advertisements

  • Understanding of Meta advertising creative testing and optimization

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating ecommerce or performance marketing work

  • Ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously

  • Excellent attention to detail and communication skills

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment

Preferred

  • Experience collaborating with paid media buyers or creative strategists

  • Familiarity with motion graphics and light animation

  • Experience using AI-powered editing tools and workflows

raw.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Veracity, we aim to be a different kind of insurance partner – one that is free from outside investors, venture capital, or the pressures of a corporate parent.
raw.description:
At Veracity, we aim to be a different kind of insurance partner – one that is free from outside investors, venture capital, or the pressures of a corporate parent.

Ours is a culture of empowerment – one that believes in effort, results, and accountability. We believe that transparency fosters trust, trust fosters growth, and that growth drives innovation. Our commitment to rigorous evaluation and relentless execution lead to rapid evolution.

We answer only to the small business owners we serve, and this independence allows us to stay focused on what matters most: helping their businesses thrive by providing expert guidance and best-in-class insurance policies.

We’re growing fast and want you to be a part of it!

We're seeking a technically sharp and organizationally influential Senior Applied AI Engineer to join our Engineering team. Veracity is building a new multi-tenant, API/MCP-first insurance platform where AI agents operate as first-class principals alongside human users – built on a deterministic core with an agentic layer. Money movement, binding, and compliance run on deterministic, auditable systems; agents handle orchestration, intake, document understanding, and workflow acceleration on top.

This is not a chatbot-building role. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you will do two jobs in one: build and harden production agent systems for a regulated insurance domain, and help define and implement our AI-first engineering and product principles – how the whole organization designs, builds, ships, and operates software with AI in the loop. This is a senior individual-contributor role with high architectural and organizational influence and a clear growth path toward technical leadership as the AI team scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and ship production agentic systems – multi-agent orchestration, tool use, RAG pipelines, and MCP-based integrations against platform APIs
  • Build the reliability layer around agents – evals, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and regression testing – so agent behavior is measurable and defensible
  • Implement maker-checker patterns so AI accelerates regulated workflows without ever autonomously touching money, bind, or compliance decisions
  • Integrate agent capabilities with the deterministic core including canonical data model, Config Hub, and Control Tower task orchestration
  • Co-author and implement our AI-first engineering principles – agent harnesses, AI-assisted code review, shared skills and prompt libraries, eval-gated CI, and dev-environment standards – then drive adoption across squads in Vilnius and the US
  • Shape AI-first product principles – where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, human-in-the-loop patterns, agent UX conventions, and how AI capability estimates change scoping and build-vs-buy decisions
  • Set the standard through your own delivery – demonstrating what AI-first engineering makes possible and establishing the reference patterns other engineers adopt
  • Work directly with engineering leadership on the AI architecture roadmap and year-end production proof points
  • Required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned

Requirements and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with strong backend or full-stack foundations – APIs, event-driven systems, and data modeling
  • Real production experience with LLM-powered systems – agent orchestration, tool calling, RAG, and structured outputs – not just prototypes or demos
  • Demonstrated ability to make agentic systems reliable – evals, fallbacks, deterministic checkpoints, and cost and latency management
  • Strong product judgment – you scope AI where it earns its place and default to deterministic code where it doesn't
  • Evidence you've changed how others build, not just how you build – workflows, harnesses, or practices you introduced that a team adopted and kept using
  • Clear written communication with comfort operating in an async-first, distributed team environment

Perks

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Amazing work-life balance with 4 weeks of Paid Time Off
  • 10 Paid Company Holidays with 2 floating holidays
  • 401K Programs with employer match
  • Personal assistance programs for support in a healthy personal and work life

Why Veracity?

Here at Veracity, you’ll be part of a team of trailblazers and visionaries. We’re not just revolutionizing the way people “do” insurance; we are creating a whole new paradigm. Here, you will experience a vibrant and inclusive workplace where your ideas matter! With us, you have a chance to:

  • Engage in groundbreaking projects that are reshaping the insurance landscape
  • Collaborate with a group of dedicated, like-minded professionals
  • Experience a culture that prioritizes growth and development

Compensation Range: $140k/yr - $170k/yr

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

If you need accommodation, please let us know during the interview process.

raw.description:
Synthomer is a leading supplier of high-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection – growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,900 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 29 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products.

At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy.

Key Account Manager – Adhesives (Hot Melt & Pressure Sensitive Adhesives)

We're looking for an experienced Key Account Manager with deep industry contacts in the adhesives market and strong expertise in hot melt and pressure-sensitive adhesive (PSA) technologies.

This role is responsible for driving profitable sales growth by identifying, developing, and executing strategic opportunities that support both the short- and long-term objectives of the Adhesive Solutions business across the Americas. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams, the Key Account Manager will build a robust opportunity pipeline, develop strategic account plans, and deliver sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business development by identifying unmet customer needs, prioritizing opportunities, coordinating internal resources, and commercializing solutions.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that outline customer strategies, key stakeholders, value chain positioning, historical performance, and growth opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers to drive business retention and expansion.
  • Document customer interactions, opportunities, and sales activities within the CRM system.
  • Deliver against agreed business targets, including sales volume, margin, profitability, and working capital objectives.
  • Leverage forecasting tools to provide accurate sales projections and business insights.
  • Monitor progress against plans, proactively communicate risks, and implement contingency actions when needed.
  • Collaborate with Technical, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to accelerate growth and enhance customer satisfaction.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline, such as Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.

raw.excerpt: About UsAt Zyte, we eat data for breakfast, and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte.
raw.description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast, and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

The Role

Zyte is seeking a Platform and Automation Engineer with strong Business Systems and Automation experience to architect and operate the internal technology ecosystem that powers our global company.

This role goes beyond endpoint management and traditional IT support — it treats internal IT as an engineering discipline, with code-first automation as the default approach. You will design and operate the backbone of Zyte's internal SaaS platform, integrating systems like Salesforce, HubSpot, finance systems, HR platforms, engineering tools, and collaboration software into a coherent, automated architecture. You'll also play a key role in introducing AI-assisted and AI-driven workflows across the company.

Requirements

Business Systems Engineering

  • Administer and integrate business-critical SaaS systems, such as:
    • Salesforce or HubSpot
    • Customer support platforms (Zendesk, Intercom, etc.)
    • Billing or subscription systems (Stripe, Chargebee, etc.)
    • Collaboration and engineering tools (Atlassian, GitHub, Notion)
  • Design reliable workflows and data synchronization across multiple SaaS platforms
  • Engineer Internal Automation Systems: You will spend a significant portion of your time writing code and building automation tooling, not just configuring SaaS products.
    Using modern development environments (IDEs, CLIs, SDKs), you will build scripts, services, and integrations that automate Zyte’s internal operations. Typical work includes:
    • writing automation scripts in Python, Go, or similar languages
    • building internal CLI tools for common IT and business workflows
    • developing small internal services that integrate the SaaS platform
    • building event-driven automation pipelines using APIs and webhooks
    • developing internal bots and ChatOps integrations.
  • Build and Maintain SaaS Integrations: Design and implement reliable, API-driven integrations between business systems, including:
    • CRM automation across Salesforce / HubSpot
    • Syncing customer, billing, and product usage data
      Automating entitlement provisioning across internal systems
      Connecting support, product, and CRM workflows..
  • Develop Internal Tools: Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency across teams, like:
    • Internal CLI tools for IT and operations.
    • Automation services for onboarding and access management.
    • Data synchronization services between internal systems.
    • Dashboards and automation services for business operations.
    • ChatOps tools for Slack or internal collaboration platforms.
  • Introduce AI into Internal Workflows: Identify opportunities to use modern AI technologies to automate or augment internal operations, examples include:
    • AI-powered internal support assistants
    • LLM-driven knowledge retrieval across internal documentation
    • Automated ticket triage and resolution
    • AI copilots for internal SaaS workflows
    • Automated analysis of operational data
  • Design the Internal "IT Golden Path": Create automated and developer-friendly workflows for employees and teams, building, for example:
    • Automated onboarding and offboarding pipelines.
    • Identity and access provisioning automation.
    • Self-service automation for common IT tasks.
    • Internal developer-friendly APIs for business systems.
  • IT Service Management & Operations: Serve as the ultimate level of IT Support for end-users, delivering superior IT assistance to a global, remote workforce. Emphasize comprehensive root-cause analysis and a 'person-first' philosophy in service delivery.
  • Security & Compliance Engineering: Ensure continuous operational adherence to established ISO frameworks. Implement and administer comprehensive endpoint security measures, including Mobile Device Management (JumpCloud), enterprise-grade password management solutions, and conduct routine access audits to rigorously enforce Zero Trust architecture principles.

Requirements

    • 8+ years in IT Engineering, Systems Engineering, Business Systems Engineering, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years in a senior role owning internal business systems and automation at a SaaS/tech company
    • Scripting Mastery: Strong scripting and programming ability in Python, Go, , Bash,.
    • Cloud Infrastructure: Solid experience operating GCP & AWS environments (VPCs, IAM roles, EC2/S3).
    • API & Integration Engineering: Strong experience working with external APIs, including:
      • REST and GraphQL APIs
      • OAuth authentication flows
      • Webhook-based event systems
      • SaaS SDKs and integration frameworks.
    • Operating Systems: Deep working knowledge of macOS and Linux environments.
    • Identity & Security: experience implementing and managing:
      • SSO / SAML / SCIM provisioning
      • Identity lifecycle automation
      • Zero Trust access models
    • Compliance & Governance: Experience supporting or passing security and compliance audits, such as:
      • ISO 27001 | SOC2 | GDPR
    • Experience working in remote-first or globally distributed environments is strongly preferred

Preferred Skills

  • AI-Assisted Automation: Experience experimenting with or implementing AI-driven automation, such as:
    • LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
    • AI copilots for operational workflows
    • Semantic search or knowledge retrieval systems
    • Automated support or ticket triage using AI
  • Containerization: Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes for running internal IT microservices
  • SRE Mindset: Experience applying SLIs/SLOs to internal IT services to measure "uptime" of the employee experience.

Who You Are

  • Autonomous: You don’t need a manual. You prioritize complex backlogs independently and lead from the front.
  • People-Centric: You have great interpersonal skills and clear communication. You solve for the person, not just the machine.
  • AI-Driven: You are enthusiastic about leveraging AI tools to automate, enhance, and continuously improve internal IT business processes.
  • Security Minded: You understand the "why" behind security frameworks and MDM, balancing safety with organizational speed.
  • Growth-Oriented: You are proactive. When you see a gap in a process, you own the solution.

Benefits

  • Total Flexibility: We are 100% remote. Work from where you are most productive.
  • Innovation Culture: We encourage "hacking" internal processes. If a task is manual, we want you to automate it.
  • Cutting Edge: Work with a tech stack that mirrors our production environment—modern, fast, and open-source-centric.
